hook: The west outfitting dock and boat ramp of the Anderson & Cristofani yard.

historic_survey.finding: Contributor to the India Basin Boat Yards, a district the survey put forward as eligible for the California Register under Criteria 1 and 3
historic_survey.eligible_district: India Basin Boat Yards (proposed; period of significance 1893–1935)
historic_survey.note: A partly submerged parcel listed in a 1947 insurance appraisal as the site of Anderson & Cristofani's "West Repair Ways – Winch House, Storage & Boiler" and the "West Outfitting Dock and New repair ways." The West Repair Ways were demolished after 1950 and that part of India Cove filled; what remains is the West Outfitting Dock, one marine railway and one concrete boat ramp.
